name: system-deep-loop
description: Unified deep-loop parent hub: the single advisor-routable home for active deep-loop personas, routing to three modes across three workflow families over a nested runtime/ infrastructure layer (formerly the separate deep-loop-runtime skill, merged 2026-07-08). research (outward web+code iterative investigation → research/ artifacts), review (iterative review loop → P0/P1/P2 findings + verdict), ai-council (multi-seat planning deliberation → ai-council/ artifacts). The hub holds no per-mode convergence, state, or synthesis logic; each mode keeps its own contract in its packet and is reachable via its /deep:* command and native agent.
